newsitem.title: SPAIN: SPAIN'S SOL MELIA DETAILS H1 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: SPAIN'S SOL MELIA DETAILS H1 EARNINGS.

text.p: Details of Sol Melia first-half results versus same period a year ago, in billions of pesetas unless stated:

NOTE - Sol Melia said in a statement its prospects for the second half remain stable. Due to seasonal effects, the second quarter is traditionally the lowest contributor to profits. The third quarter will better reflect the benefits of a moderately positive summer season.

The closing of several hotels and partial closings for renovation will limit revenues for the coming quarters. Sol Melia said the exchange rate of sterling and the dollar versus the peseta have had a positive net effect on results and should help profits in the third quarter.
The company said operating margins continue to improve.

Recent deals in Mexico and Venezuela were examples of efforts to focus on fewer, bigger projects, the company said. The investments are forecast to provide around 200 and 300 million pesetas respectively in management fees per year.
The company said it was concerned about how the rising dollar will affect demand for Cuba from European visitors.
